(a) Were both bodies initially moving, or was one initially stationary? Which line segment corresponds to the mo- tion of the center of mass (b) before the collision and (c) after the col- lision? (d) Is the mass of the body that was moving faster before the collision greater than,less than,or equal to that of the other body? 10 Figure 9-32: A block on a horizontal floor is initially either stationary, sliding in the positive direction of an x axis, or sliding in the negative direction of that axis. Six choices for a graph of the momenta of the block and the pieces are given, all versus time t.
